semantics.container: a class that is the pid of another class is a container; containers with 0 own items are excluded from coverage
semantics.idsArePerEndpoint: category ids differ between mirrors of the same brand (搜AV .vip/.com vs .net; 老色逼 apilsbzy1 vs laosebizy*): always key by api URL, never by brand, and map by NAME at runtime
